comparisons.label: Target Customer Identification
comparisons.questionText: Who are your target customers? Define your audience as specifically as possible. (Demographics, Psychographics)

pre.answer: This will be focused towards a young adult and older audience, from 18+, but it will also cater to kids in a price friendly way. It will cater to both men and women who are more interested in replicating scents from when they were younger, or scents that have been discontinued, or a scent that they would like to modify. Location wise I am thinking about all around the world, with an emphasis in California, New York, Italy, France, China, and the Middle East, as they seem to like perfumes a lot. Income wise, I want my brand to cater to all brands and have a range of prices depending on how unique you want your perfume. The main focus would be to wealthier people who are willing to spend a lot on a good quality perfume.

post.answer:
Young adults (18-25): those looking for affordable, unique and nostalgic scents, lower income, willing to try new things and be different from the rest.
Mature adults: those looking to relive the past through scent, luxurious scents, and personalization, higher income.
Across the globe: those looking to experience another culture through scent, higher income.

The response is somewhat more structured and detailed but does not multiply dimensions; the original audience scope is largely preserved.
